description: This file provides a detailed description of a file observer mechanism using inotify on Linux systems, including class implementation, usage examples, and a sample main function to demonstrate monitoring a file or directory for changes.

classes.name: FileChangeMonitor
classes.description: A class that monitors a specific file or directory for changes using inotify, invoking a callback when modifications occur.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Callback method invoked when the monitored file or directory changes.
